observations: Pip metadata operations exclude PYTHONPATH in that child process to avoid unrelated CANN-distribution dependency metadata; CANN imports and NPU execution must preserve set_env.sh PYTHONPATH.

Conda clone may relink old conda payload over newer pip-installed files while leaving metadata unchanged; build clone was repaired by force-reinstall of the pip lock and actual NumPy/TBE imports were rechecked.
av and pynini are supplied only by the explicit conda artifacts; the final pip lock removes redundant satisfied entries.
